stories.title: Anthropic IPO: calls to delay over safety, valuation debate
stories.summary: Anthropic faces calls to delay its IPO over AI safety concerns while investors weigh a $1.5T valuation instead of the earlier $2T figure.

top_posts.author: @benjamincowen
top_posts.text: Translation: Market conditions are not great right now, so let's delay our IPO to extract as much out of retail as possible later on. But let's blame it on safety concerns.

top_posts.author: @DeItaone
top_posts.text:
ANTHROPIC’S IPO VALUATION EXPECTATIONS DROP FROM $2 TRILLION TO $1.5 TRILLION

Some investors are considering a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, down 25% from earlier expectations of $2 trillion.

Anthropic reported $16.8 billion in Q3 revenue, up 45% quarter

top_posts.author: @DeItaone
top_posts.text:
ANTHROPIC FACES CALL TO DELAY MASSIVE IPO OVER AI SAFETY CONCERNS

Anthropic has opened discussions with NYC Comptroller Mark Levine after he urged the company to postpone its planned IPO until it addresses AI safety and governance risks.

Levine oversees public pension funds hol

top_posts.author: @clmt
top_posts.text: Lots of you were asking – Gemini 4 Argon is now available to ALL Pro users on @antigravity!

stories.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft with no human help
stories.summary: Google DeepMind says four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a shared world beat Minecraft from scratch, defeating the Ender Dragon in 27 hours using only code.

top_posts.author: @GoogleDeepMind
top_posts.text:
Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours.

Operating in a sandbox using only code and text, they wrote 2,783 programs, divided up jobs over chat, shared notes, and debugged errors together - all with no human help ↓
https://t.co/uyIhDOQXGT

top_posts.author: @maxencefaldor
top_posts.text: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents, one shared Minecraft world, one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. 27 hours and 2,783 self-written programs later, the dragon fell. https://t.co/Cx7Djg1VTx
